name: twinmcp
description: Up-to-date library documentation for your prompts, from TwinMCP
long_description: TwinMCP Docs pulls version-specific documentation and code examples for a library from the TwinMCP API and places them in your prompt. It needs a TwinMCP API key (ctx7sk_), created in the dashboard at https://twinmcp.fr/dashboard.

api_key.title: TwinMCP API key
api_key.description: Your TwinMCP API key (starts with ctx7sk_). Create one at https://twinmcp.fr/dashboard.

tools.name: Resolve TwinMCP Library ID
tools.description: Resolves a package/product name to a TwinMCP-compatible library ID and returns matching libraries.

tools.name: Query Documentation
tools.description: Retrieves and queries up-to-date documentation and code examples from TwinMCP.
